article:
The last thing Nora remembered was the taste of bitter coffee. Then there was darkness. Now she was sitting in the same café, on the same rainy Monday, with Maya smiling across the table.

"Drink it before it gets cold," Maya said. Nora stared at the cup. In her first life, she had drunk it, collapsed on the train, and never woken up.

A transparent blue box appeared above Maya's head. [MISSION 014: Make Nora finish the coffee.] [REWARD: 500 POINTS.] Nora blinked. The words remained.

She could see the system. But why was the task about her?

Maya pushed the cup closer. "You look pale. Are you okay?" "Perfect," Nora said. "You first."

Maya's smile twitched. "What?" "Take a sip. I want to know if it's too sweet." "I already had mine." "Then you won't mind another one."

For a second, Maya looked toward the door. A man near the window raised his phone. Another blue box appeared above his head. [MISSION 015: Record Nora drinking the coffee.] [REWARD: 200 POINTS.]

Nora's hands went cold. They were working together. At least, they thought they were.

Nora raised her cup. Maya relaxed. The man angled his camera toward her. Nora tilted the cup, then poured the coffee into the plant beside her. "Oops," she said.

Both boxes flashed red. [MISSION FAILED.] [COMPENSATION RULE ACTIVATED: TARGET RESISTED AN UNDISCLOSED TASK.] [500 POINTS TRANSFERRED TO TARGET.] [200 POINTS TRANSFERRED TO TARGET.]

A third box opened in front of Nora. [BALANCE: 700 POINTS.] [WELCOME TO THE STORE.]

Nora nearly laughed. She had never been a player. She was the target. And apparently the system paid targets who refused to cooperate.

Maya grabbed her wrist. "What did you do?" Nora pulled her hand away. "Nothing," she said. "You should check your account."

Maya's face drained of color. Behind her, the man's phone buzzed. Nora saw a new message rise above his head. [URGENT MISSION: ELIMINATE THE TARGET BEFORE MIDNIGHT.] [REWARD: 50,000 POINTS.]

Nora stopped smiling.

Then another message appeared, this time only in front of her. [SECRET MISSION UNLOCKED.] [MAKE THE HUNTER ASK FOR MERCY.]

lesson.title: Everyone Has a Mission
lesson.subtitle: 重生后，我看见了反派的系统

grammar.label: PAST PERFECT
grammar.meaning: 过去完成时：表示更早发生的经历
grammar.quote: In her first life, she had drunk it, collapsed on the train, and never woken up.
grammar.explain: 叙述主角重生后的现在场景时使用一般过去时；回顾更早的上一世遭遇时，可用 had + 过去分词。
grammar.example: She had already seen the message before he arrived.

lesson.question: How did Nora turn the system against Maya?
lesson.questionHelp: Retell the coffee scene in 60 seconds. Explain the loophole in your own words.
sentence_translations: 诺拉最后记得的，是那杯苦咖啡的味道。
现在她又坐在同一家咖啡馆里，同一个下雨的星期一，玛雅正坐在对面朝她微笑。
上一世，她喝下咖啡，在火车上倒下，再也没醒来。
玛雅头顶突然出现一个半透明的蓝色框。
但为什么任务目标是她自己？
玛雅把杯子往前推了推。
我想知道它是不是太甜。”
窗边一个男人举起了手机。
另一块蓝色任务框出现在他头顶。
【任务015：拍下诺拉喝咖啡的视频。】
至少，他们自己这么以为。
那个男人把摄像头对准她。
诺拉倾斜杯子，把咖啡倒进旁边的盆栽。
两个任务框同时闪起红光。
【补偿规则已触发：目标人物抵抗了未公开的任务。】
第三个任务框出现在诺拉面前。
而现在看来，目标人物拒绝配合，系统反而会付给她积分。
玛雅一把抓住她的手腕。
玛雅的脸一下子没了血色。
她身后那个男人的手机响了。
诺拉看见他的头顶又浮现出一条消息。
【紧急任务：午夜前清除目标人物。】
然后另一条消息出现了，这次只有她能看到。

cards.quote: In her first life, she had drunk it, collapsed on the train, and never woken up.
cards.ex: In my first life, I trusted everyone.
cards.tip: 用于重生题材；英语中 first life 比 previous lifetime 更直观。

cards.ex: Take a sip and tell me what you think.
cards.tip: sip 指一小口；take a sip of coffee/tea 都很常见。

cards.ex: My blood went cold when I read the note.
cards.tip: go + 形容词表示状态变化，这里表现人物惊恐。

cards.zh: 看来；显然（根据所见推断）
cards.quote: And apparently the system paid targets who refused to cooperate.
cards.ex: Apparently, nobody told her the truth.
cards.tip: 根据现有证据判断，不代表百分之百确定。

cards.ex: He asked for mercy, but she walked away.
cards.tip: ask for mercy 常见于戏剧性情节，语气强烈。

lesson.synopsis: 一杯咖啡、一套任务系统，和一次意外的反击。

annotations.explain: taste of + 食物/饮料，描写回忆中的味觉。
annotations.example: I still remember the taste of that tea.

annotations.explain: 重生小说中用来对比两个不同的人生阶段。
annotations.example: In her first life, she never met him.

annotations.explain: A transparent screen = 透明的屏幕。
collapse 常描述突然失去支撑或倒下。
take a sip of coffee = 喝一小口咖啡。
annotations.example: She took a sip of water.

annotations.explain: look toward 表示看向某个方向。
angle 可作动词，表示调整方向或角度。
annotations.example: He angled the mirror toward the light.

annotations.explain: pour 强调液体连续流出。
annotations.example: She poured the milk into a glass.

annotations.explain: 在系统提示中指因规则触发而获得的补偿。
系统把 Nora 当作任务目标，不是执行者。
annotations.example: She was the target of the plan.

annotations.explain: 表示根据目前获得的信息作出推断。
形容惊吓或紧张时面色突然变化。
系统任务中具有威胁意味。
annotations.example: The company tried to eliminate waste.

annotations.explain: before 加时间，表示截止时间之前。
表示请求对方停止惩罚或伤害。
